subject: geography
title: Where in the world is India?

nodes: 3.28 million sq. km: the seventh largest country
The largest democracy in the world
props.label: p.52

scenes.narration: India, that is Bharat, is a vast land of mountains, plains, plateaus, rivers, deserts and coastlines. It is the seventh largest country in the world, the most populous, and the largest democracy.

India is in the southern part of Asia. It is a peninsula: a land surrounded by water on three sides. The Arabian Sea is to the west, the Bay of Bengal to the east, and the Indian Ocean to the south. The Himalayas are in the north.

nodes: Latitude: 8° 4′ N to 37° 6′ N (south to north)
Longitude: 68° 7′ E to 97° 25′ E (west to east)
The Tropic of Cancer: almost through the centre
props.label: p.53

scenes.narration: India is in the Northern and Eastern hemispheres. The mainland stretches from 8 degrees 4 minutes north to 37 degrees 6 minutes north, and the Tropic of Cancer passes through almost the centre.
